title: SafeAdapt-Poker: Counterfactual Risk Calibration for Budgeted Adaptation under Opponent Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.20473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Opponent histories can mislead after behavioral shifts. SafeAdapt-Poker formulates budgeted adaptation under opponent shift as a dual-counterfactual sequential-control problem using only information available before each decision. At each decision the controller asks two distinct questions: what local downside a deviation from the frozen anchor would induce under matched legal continuations, and what future adaptation value would be lost by consuming part of the remaining deviation budget now. The first question is answered by a monotone strategic-risk model over deviation intensity; the second by a paired budget-state continuation model that prices current budget consumption. The controller selects among support-preserving candidate deviations by trading immediate adaptation value against these two quantities, a pathwise cumulative-KL ledger bounds total anchor-relative deviation, and a finite family of frozen controllers is screened

translated_title: SafeAdapt-Poker：对手漂移下预算化适应的反事实风险校准
translated_abstract: 在行为发生漂移后，对手的历史行为记录可能会产生误导。SafeAdapt-Poker 将对手漂移下的预算化适应问题表述为一个双重反事实序贯控制问题，仅使用每次决策之前可获得的信息。在每次决策时，控制器会提出两个不同的问题：一是在匹配的合法后续情形下，偏离冻结锚点会引发怎样的局部下行风险；二是现在消耗一部分剩余偏离预算会损失多少未来的适应价值。第一个问题由一个关于偏离强度的单调策略风险模型来回答；第二个问题则由一个配对的预算状态延续模型来回答，该模型为当前的预算消耗定价。控制器通过将即时适应价值与这两个量进行权衡，在保持支撑集的候选偏离中进行选择；一条逐路径的累计KL散度账本对相对于锚点的总偏离量进行约束；同时从一组有限的冻结控制器中进行筛选。
tldr: 该论文提出 SafeAdapt-Poker，将对手漂移下的预算化适应建模为仅依赖决策前信息的双重反事实序贯控制问题，通过单调策略风险模型与配对预算状态延续模型分别校准偏离的局部下行风险和预算消耗的未来代价，并用逐路径累计KL账本约束总偏离量，从而在即时适应价值与安全风险之间实现可校准的权衡。
en_tdlr: SafeAdapt-Poker formulates budgeted adaptation under opponent shift as a dual-counterfactual sequential-control problem that, using only pre-decision information, trades immediate adaptation value against a monotone strategic-risk model of deviation downside and a paired budget-state continuation model that prices current budget consumption, while a pathwise cumulative-KL ledger bounds total anchor-relative deviation and a finite family of frozen controllers is screened.
